paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 11:1; Hyman says that undoubtedly the reading should be R' Abba bar Kahana.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rav Ahavah follows the full wording רב אהבה בר כהנא in the Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Vayikra Rabbah 11:1, expanding the supplied abbreviated title. Hyman’s “undoubtedly” is preserved for his proposed Abba reading; this witness itself has Ahavah.

The saved TE Vayikra Rabbah11:1 scalar explicitly has Rav Ahavah bar Kahana, supporting heading Rav. It does not give Abba there; Hyman’s undoubtedly should-be Abba emendation retains its full force as his statement, with that occurrence’s abbreviated title kept as R'. The older immaterial-title/no-note decision is qualified: the source/witness rank distinction is now explicit.
